name: Open World
author: htubdawg
description: Free roam in a 32 km (20 mile) square world built from a fixed seed: two towns joined by a highway, villages linked by rural roads, mountain ranges and a mountain wall at the edge, streamed in tiles around the car. Built in the Tokyo scene; the weather is drawn each race. A floating origin keeps the physics precise anywhere in the world. Works in Multiplayer rooms with the Multiplayer mod as it is.
